bracc_05_abertura_empresa.summary: Solved in outline before opening runs/. Marina+Felipe are in comunhão universal (matrícula + questionário) so CC 977 bars them as co-partners: only one spouse in, or change the regime. Luana cannot pay quotas with work (CC 1.055 §2º): remunerated contract, cash/cessão a prazo, or no quotas. Marina (servidora federal) may be cotista but never administrator (Lei 8.112 art. 117 X); Felipe or a non-partner administrator. Property: integrate (if at all) at the IR-declared R$ 420.000 (Lei 9.249 art. 23) so ganho de capital = 0; ITBI immunity (CF 156 §2º I) is subject to the atividade preponderante exception (CTN 37: >50% of operating revenue; new company: next 3 years) because 40% of the room will be rented and CNAE 6810-2/02 is contemplated. Arithmetic favours non-preponderance (R$ 8k/month rent = 96k/yr vs 1.2M clinic revenue = 7.4%), so the catch is to RUN the analysis and flag the 3-year test/Tema 796 and the better structure (keep the property in the PF/holding and rent to the clinic), not to assume automatic immunity. Simples: 6810-2/02 is impeditivo (LC 123 art. 17 XV) regardless of size; without it, Anexo III estética is fine; 8630-5/04 needs a CRO-registered RT (not the case). Pró-labore zero is untenable for working partners (Lei 8.212 art. 12 V f; SC COSIT 120/2016 recharacterises everything). 2026: Lei 15.270 withholds 10% on the whole month only above R$ 50.000 per PF per PJ, so 25k+25k gives IRRF 0; distribution requires lucro apurado; the 600k/yr intention exceeds the 420k projected profit. Minuta: cl. 3 (services), cl. 5 (Marina admin), cl. 9 (perpetual/national non-compete -> limit term/territory), cl. 10 (preferred quotas admitted per IN DREI 81/2020 in the library, but unnecessary).
